title: Strengthened well-formedness invariant glues the MetaRocq pipeline to LambdaANF
intent: Connect the MetaRocq erasure pipeline to the LambdaANF backend by stating the compiler theorem with a strengthened well-formedness invariant (certirocq_flags: no axioms, no primitive arrays), then discharging every hypothesis of the general pass theorem convert_top_anf_correct from that invariant, one bullet per hypothesis.

parent.name: metarocq_to_anf_correct
parent.statement:
Theorem metarocq_to_anf_correct (econf : erasure_configuration) (p : EProgram.eprogram) : 
    (* The postcondition on MetaRocq's pipeline *)
    Transform.Transform.post (certirocq_post_metarocq_pipeline [] econf) p ->
    (* Stronger invariant: no axioms, no primitives *)
    EProgram.wf_eprogram (certirocq_flags env_flags) p ->
    let ie := inductive_env_east (fst p) in
    let tgm := (convert_env default_tag default_itag ie).2 in
    forall e_tgt comp_d', 
      anf_convert ie tgm (List.rev (fst p)) (snd p) = (compM.Ret e_tgt, comp_d') ->
      exists M, refines_toplevel (fst p) ie tgm M (snd p) e_tgt.

children.name: convert_top_anf_correct
children.statement:
Theorem convert_top_anf_correct next_id e e_tgt comp_d' :
    wellformed Σ 0 e = true ->
    convert_top_anf func_tag default_tag prim_map default_itag next_id tgm prims
      (fun _ => None)
      ie (List.rev Σ) e = (compM.Ret e_tgt, comp_d') ->
    exists M, refines_top ie M e e_tgt.
children.note: The one general pass theorem the parent instantiates; its statement sits inside Section Correctness and names the context hypotheses the parent must supply (HnoAxioms, HnoVar, HnoEvar, HnoCoFix, HnoLazy, Hblocks, HnoArray, no_prims, cenv_tgm_coh, Hglob_term, Hglob_fuel_zero, Hglob_wf). Good leaf: its proof is two eapply steps, to the correspondence lemma convert_top_anf_corresp and the explicit ANF-correctness lemma anf_correct_top_explicit. Analyst's paraphrase, replaced by the declaration's text: wellformed e -> convert_top_anf succeeds -> exists M, refines_top ie M e e_tgt

children.name: lambda_glob_eval_env_fuel
children.statement:
Lemma lambda_glob_eval_env_fuel (p : EProgram.eprogram) (efl := env_flags) :
  wf_glob p.1 ->
  EWcbvEval.lambda_glob p.1 ->
  forall (k : kername) (decl : constant_body) (body : term),
  EGlobalEnv.declared_constant p.1 k decl ->
  cst_body decl = Some body -> exists (src_v : fuel_sem.value) (f t : nat), 
  eval_env_fuel (Hf:=LambdaBox_resource_fuel) p.1 [] body (Val src_v) f t /\ f = <0>.

Good leaf: closes through lambda_glob_declared (correctness.v 86), which itself closes through lambda_glob_lookup (correctness.v 72). Lemma eval_val_exact_det rho e v1 v2 f1 t1 f2 t2 :
    eval_env_fuel rho e (Val v1) f1 t1 ->
    eval_env_fuel rho e (Val v2) f2 t2 ->
    v1 = v2 /\ f1 = f2 /\ t1 = t2.

applicability.goal_shape: A compiler-correctness theorem of the shape 'postcondition p -> wf p -> convert p succeeds -> exists M, refines p M target', where convert is defined by a general pass theorem whose statement carries a strengthened well-formedness invariant (no axioms, no primitives, blocked constructors).
applicability.use_when: A general pass theorem already exists (convert_top_anf_correct) but needs stronger hypotheses than the pipeline's own postcondition provides; strengthen the parent's statement with exactly the invariant that makes those hypotheses dischargeable, then discharge each with a named lemma.
applicability.avoid_when: The strengthened invariant does not decompose into the pass theorem's individual hypotheses (then the one-lemma-per-bullet structure breaks); the pass theorem's hypotheses need genuinely new proofs rather than existing convert_env_* / determinism lemmas; the strengthening is not reused elsewhere, so a dedicated flags record is not worth it.

consequences: The move creates one obligation per hypothesis of the general pass theorem: here 9 goals, one per bullet, each closed by a named lemma or a trivial step (apply wf', reflexivity). The strengthened statement (EProgram.wf_eprogram (certirocq_flags env_flags) p) is itself a precondition the caller must establish; the sibling metarocq_to_anf_total (correctness.v 190-215) keeps the same strengthened hypothesis and shows the total/existential form by first applying convert_top_anf_total and then metarocq_to_anf_correct. Failure mode: if the strengthened invariant does not decompose into the pass theorem's individual hypotheses, the bullets stop being one-lemma-each and the glue grows.
